name: Escape Quicksand for Brainrots!
desc:
Welcome to Escape Quicksand for Brainrots!

Run fast and grab Brainrots! 🏃
One wrong step and the Quicksand drags you down! ⏳
Survive as long as you can with your Brainrots! ⚡
Upgrade Brainrots to boost your earnings! 💸
Upgrade your base to unlock slots to place even more Brainrots! 🏗️

Like the game and join the group! 👍
